title: RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 Out – CEN 05/2026 CBT Hall Ticket Download
desc: RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 (CEN 05/2026) out for the CBT on 23 and 25 November 2026. Download with registration number and date of birth.
headline:
RRB Paramedical Admit Card
Out Now · CBT 23 & 25 Nov
intro: The Railway Recruitment Boards have released the RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 for CEN 05/2026. The Computer Based Test is scheduled on 23 and 25 November 2026.

The admit card for the 23 November exam was released on 19 November, and the card for the 25 November batch is released four days before that exam. Candidates can download it using their registration number and date of birth.
table: Released 4 days before each exam date
steps: Visit the official website of your RRB region.
Click on the CEN 05/2026 (Paramedical) e-Call Letter link.
Log in with your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
Download the e-call letter and take a printout.
Carry it with an original photo ID to the exam centre.
details: Candidate name, photo and roll number
Exam date, shift and reporting time
faq: When is the RRB Paramedical CBT 2026?

Log in on your RRB regional website with registration number and date of birth.

Four days before the respective exam date.
final: Download your RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 and verify your exam details. All the best!
